SQL_Text: ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_U_UpdateDCApproval] (     @KRS_Id BIGINT,     @DC_Approved BIT = NULL,     @DC_Approved_Remarks NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,     @DC_ApprovedBy INT ) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      -- Helps EDMX detect result columns     IF 1 = 0     BEGIN         SELECT              CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS KRS_Id,             CAST(NULL AS BIT) AS DC_Approved,             CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS DC_Approved_Remarks,             CAST(NULL AS INT) AS DC_ApprovedBy,             CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS DC_ApprovedDate;     END;      UPDATE [EkhataTest].[dbo].[KRS]     SET         KRS_IS_DC_Approved = @DC_Approved,         KRS_DC_Approved_Remarks = @DC_Approved_Remarks,         KRS_DC_Approved_By = @DC_ApprovedBy,         KRS_DC_Approved_Date = GETDATE()     WHERE KRS_Id = @KRS_Id;      SELECT          CAST(KRS_Id AS BIGINT) AS KRS_Id,         CAST(KRS_IS_DC_Approved AS BIT) AS DC_Approved,         CAST(KRS_DC_Approved_Remarks AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS DC_Approved_Remarks,         CAST(KRS_DC_Approved_By AS INT) AS DC_ApprovedBy,         CAST(KRS_DC_Approved_Date AS DATETIME) AS DC_ApprovedDate     FROM [EkhataTest].[dbo].[KRS]     WHERE KRS_Id = @KRS_Id; END

SQL_Text: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_S_GetAdrApplications_DashData] (     @KRS_CBy BIGINT ) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      DECLARE @mobileNo NVARCHAR(20);       /* Get citizen mobile number */     SELECT TOP 1         @mobileNo = Citz_MNo     FROM mst_citizen WITH (NOLOCK)     WHERE Citz_Id = @KRS_CBy       AND Citz_Active = 1;       /* Get KRS data for CaseWorker's mapped zone */     SELECT DISTINCT          CASE             WHEN K.KRS_EPID IS NULL THEN ''             ELSE CAST(K.KRS_EPID AS NVARCHAR(50))         END AS KRS_EPID,          K.KRS_Id,         K.KRS_PNR,          M.GBAZoneName_En AS ZoneName,          '' AS DivisionName,          '' AS WardName,          sts.Sts_Name,          K.KRS_IS_DC_Approved,          CASE             WHEN K.KRS_SASNo IS NULL                  OR K.KRS_SASNo = ''                  OR K.KRS_SASNo = '0'             THEN '-'             ELSE K.KRS_SASNo         END AS SASNo,          CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), K.KRS_CDte, 103) AS ApplicationDate      FROM KRS K WITH (NOLOCK)      INNER JOIN [masterdb_preprod].[dbo].[mst_AROMapping] M WITH (NOLOCK)         ON K.KRS_ZoneId = M.BBMPZoneID      INNER JOIN mst_CaseWorker CW WITH (NOLOCK)         ON CW.cw_UserZoneId = M.GBAZoneID         AND CW.cw_IsActive = 1      INNER JOIN KRS_PropDetailsAsPerDeed APD WITH (NOLOCK)         ON K.KRS_Id = APD.PDAD_KRS_ID      INNER JOIN Mst_AppStatus sts WITH (NOLOCK)         ON sts.Sts_Id = K.KRS_MStsId      WHERE         CW.cw_UserRoleId = 4         AND CW.cw_UserMobile = @mobileNo          AND K.KRS_Active = 1         AND K.KRS_MStsId >= 8          AND APD.PDAD_IsDeedBeforeOrAfter2004 = 'tdr'      ORDER BY         K.KRS_Id DESC;  END

SQL_Text: CREATE proc [dbo].[USP_S_ValidateDCOTP]           @OTP int,           @MobileNO nvarchar(20) --@DeviceID NVARCHAR(20)           as           begin           declare @Count int=0      declare @thresholdLockValue int =4    set  @Count= (select Count(*) from OTP_Tran where otp=@OTP  and MobileNO=@MobileNO and DATEDIFF(MINUTE, cdte,getdate()) <5 and ACTIVE is null    )              print @count    if @count =0 or @Count is null or @Count =''       begin     --check if user is valid and update the failed attempt     update mst_citizen set NoOfFailedAttempt = ISNULL(NoOfFailedAttempt,0)+1 ,    Citz_ACTIVE = case when NoOfFailedAttempt <= @thresholdLockValue then 1 else 0 end,    Citz_AdditionalInfo = case when NoOfFailedAttempt <= @thresholdLockValue then Citz_AdditionalInfo else 'Account is deactivated because of multiple invalid attempts' end ,  Citz_Locked_Date=GETDATE()   where   Citz_MNo=@MobileNO and Citz_RolId=4              end   else    begin     update mst_citizen set NoOfFailedAttempt = 0    where   Citz_MNo=@MobileNO    and Citz_Active=1 and Citz_RolId=4   end         --delete from DCA_OTP where otp=@OTP and  MobileNO= @MobileNO           --update OTP_Tran set ACTIVE=1 where otp=@OTP and  MobileNO=@MobileNO                             SELECT     case when  (@Count>0 and Citz_Active=1)  then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end  isvalidOTP  ,          Citz_Id,  Citz_MNo  , Citz_RolId,Citz_name,citz_zoneid,citz_divisionid,citz_wardid ,     Citz_AdditionalInfo AdditionalInfo,NoOfFailedAttempt      FROM mst_citizen USR            where    Citz_MNo=@MobileNO and Citz_RolId=4             end

SQL_Text: --ALTER TABLE BtoAMainApp ADD App_IsGovtProperty  bit     alter PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_I_BtoA_JC_Conclusion] ( 	@Level int,     @App_Id INT,     @Conclusion NVARCHAR(200),     @Remarks NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,     @CRole INT,     @CBy INT, 	@JC_Concluded_ResidentialAreainSqmt float =null, 	@JC_Concluded_CommercialAreainSqmt float =null, 	@JC_Concluded_IndustrialAreainSqmt float =null ) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      BEGIN TRY         BEGIN TRANSACTION; 		if(@Level =1 )  --Govt or Private Land Conclusion 		BEGIN 		--truncate table BtoA_JC_Conclusion_GovtLand_MstPlan 		print 'Govt or Private Land Conclusion'         INSERT INTO BtoA_JC_Conclusion_GovtLand_MstPlan         (             App_Id,             Conclusion,             Remarks,             CDte,             CRole,             CBy, 			isActive 			         )         VALUES         (             @App_Id,             @Conclusion,             @Remarks,             GETDATE(),             @CRole,             @CBy,1 			         ); 	  		IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 		BEGIN  		--	ALTER table BtoA_MainApp_Officer  add Ofcr_Existing_IsGovtProperty bit 				UPDATE MA 			SET 				MA.App_PropertyVerified     = 1, 				MA.App_PropertyVerifiedDate = GETDATE(), 				MA.App_IsGovtProperty       = IIF(@Conclusion = 'Government', 1, 0), 				MA.App_AdditionalInfo       = 'Property is verified by JC' 			FROM BtoAMainApp MA 			WHERE MA.App_Id = @App_Id 			  AND @Conclusion IN ('Government', 'Private');  			     			  	UPDATE MA SET Ofcr_Existing_IsGovtProperty=Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 			MA.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty = CASE WHEN @Conclusion = 'Government' THEN 1  			WHEN @Conclusion = 'Private' THEN 0 END, MA.UDte = GETDATE(),  			MA.Ofcr_Aditional = ISNULL(MA.Ofcr_Aditional, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(MA.Ofcr_Aditional, '') = '' THEN '' ELSE ' '  			END + 'Property is Concluded by JC: ' + @Conclusion  			FROM BtoA_MainApp_Officer MA WHERE MA.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = @App_Id AND @Conclusion IN ('Government', 'Private');   			 			SELECT 				NULL AS Exception, 				CONVERT(BIT, 1) AS Status, 				CASE  					WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(@Conclusion)) IN ('Private Land', 'Government Land') 					THEN 'The property has been verified successfully' 					ELSE 'The property has been verified successfully' 				END AS MessageToDisplay, 				200 AS responseCode;
